capabilities: Zoom into a list branch and navigate back with breadcrumbs
Move, indent, and outdent whole branches with their children
Drag complete branches between notes open side by side
Fold and unfold child branches from indentation guides
Keep typed text in lists and the caret out of list markers
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.0 or later; release files include GitHub artifact attestations for verifying provenance. Formatting on save depends on other plugins being installed.
intentEvidence: Bullet is a fork of vslinko/obsidian-outliner.
problem: Obsidian's editor treats list items individually, so working with long nested lists lacks outliner-style zoom, whole-branch rearrangement, and moving branches between notes.

relations.evidence: Bullet is a fork of vslinko/obsidian-outliner.
combine Prettier, selected Linter rules, Automatic Linker, and an optional JavaScript module

summary: List editor that turns nested Markdown lists into an outliner with branch zoom, whole-branch moves, cross-note drag-and-drop, and guide-based folding.
